english.title: Use software to facilitate a purchase of tickets in excess of the sales limit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used software, namely **(..SPECIFY SOFTWARE..), designed to enable or facilitate the purchase of tickets for a recreational, sporting or cultural event in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY EVENT..), using an electronic communications network or electronic communications service, with the intention of obtaining tickets in excess of the sales limit and with a view to

(A)_[making a financial gain for yourself]_
(B)_[making a financial gain for another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3 and 5 of the Breaching of Limits on Ticket Sales Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used software
designed to enable / facilitate completion of any part of a process
to purchase tickets for a recreational / sporting / cultural event in the UK
using an electronic communications network or an electronic communications service
where there was a limit to the number of tickets a purchaser may buy
with the intent to obtain tickets in excess of that limit
with a view to any person obtaining financial gain

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) For the purposes of this offence, it does not matter whether the offer of tickets, or anything done to obtain tickets, is carried out in or outside the United Kingdom - see regulation 4.
